public_reply_templates.label: Standard — most common
public_reply_templates.trigger: They ask for info, contact, or how to reach us
public_reply_templates.template:
Of course! Here's everything you need 🛠️

📞 Call: [CAMPAIGN PHONE NUMBER]
🌐 [CAMPAIGN URL]
📘 Follow us on Facebook: [CAMPAIGN URL]

We install and repair fences around Chicago and nearby suburbs — wood, vinyl, chain link, iron, gates, residential and commercial.
notes: Emoji used as visual separator — easy to scan on mobile
Website gives them a place to review the company
Mentions main fence types without turning the reply into a long sales pitch
Keeps the reply public but not overly aggressive

public_reply_templates.label: Short version — when they just say 'interested!'
public_reply_templates.trigger: Short positive reply — 'We're interested!', 'Love this!', 'Need this!'
public_reply_templates.template: Awesome — glad to hear it! Give us a call at [CAMPAIGN PHONE NUMBER] or check us out at [CAMPAIGN URL] 🛠️
notes: Matches their energy — short and enthusiastic
Website as secondary option for those who prefer browsing first
No info dump — keeps it conversational

public_reply_templates.label: When they say 'DM me' or 'Message me'
public_reply_templates.trigger: They explicitly ask to be contacted privately
public_reply_templates.template: Will do! Sending you a message now — you can also reach us at [CAMPAIGN PHONE NUMBER] or [CAMPAIGN URL] if it's easier 🛠️
notes: Leaves public comment short — details go in the DM
Gives them direct contact as backup
Bot then sends DM with full D1 template content
